mapper.sql: select id, schedule_date, cx_batch_no, batch_no, order_no, big_roll_code, machine_id, steel_strip_code1, steel_strip_code2, unit_consume1, stock1_qty1, stock1_qty2, cutting_angle, supply_time1, day_plan_qty1, day_finish_qty1, day_produce_order1, day_finish_rate1, day_sys_analysis1, day_hand_analysis1, night_plan_qty1, night_finish_qty1, night_produce_order1, night_finish_rate1, night_sys_analysis1, night_hand_analysis1, cx_class1_plan, cx_class2_plan, cx_class3_plan, cx_class4_plan, cx_class5_plan, is_release, mark_close_out_tip, production_status, data_source, remark, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from t_cd15_assist_schedule

a.id, a.schedule_date, a.cx_batch_no, a.batch_no, a.order_no, a.big_roll_code, a.machine_id, a.steel_strip_code1, a.steel_strip_code2, a.unit_consume1, a.stock1_qty1, a.stock1_qty2, a.supply_time1, a.day_plan_qty1, a.day_produce_order1, a.day_sys_analysis1, a.day_hand_analysis1, a.night_plan_qty1, a.night_produce_order1, a.night_sys_analysis1, a.night_hand_analysis1, a.cx_class1_plan, a.cx_class2_plan, a.cx_class3_plan, a.cx_class4_plan, a.cx_class5_plan, a.is_release, a.mark_close_out_tip, a.production_status, a.remark, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time,a.CUTTING_ANGLE,a.data_source,
mapper.select:
select * from ( select
(NVL(day_plan_qty1, 0) + NVL(night_plan_qty1, 0)) as daily_total_qty, b.MONTH_PLAN_QTY as month_plan, CEIL(b.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY) as month_plan_os from t_cd15_assist_schedule a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MATERIAL_CODE,MONTH_PLAN_QTY,MONTH_REMAIN_QTY FROM T_CD15_MONTH_PLAN_SURPLUS WHERE del_flag='0' and YEAR=#{year,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and MONTH=#{month,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) b on a.steel_strip_code1=b.MATERIAL_CODE where a.del_flag='0' and a.schedule_date = #{scheduleDate,jdbcType=DATE}
and INSTR(a.big_roll_code, #{bigRollCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and instr(','||a.machine_id||',', ','||#{machineId}||',')>0
and INSTR(a.steel_strip_code1, #{steelStripCode1,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and INSTR(a.steel_strip_code2, #{steelStripCode2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) > 0
and a.IS_RELEASE = #{isRelease ,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by (case when instr(machine_id,',') > 0 then machine_id when machine_id is null or machine_id = '' then '0' else '-1' end) desc/*多个机台 和 没有机台的排在前面*/, a.big_roll_code,a.CUTTING_ANGLE asc ) t
order by ${orderStr}
